about.heading: About Me
about.p1: I've been writing code since I was 13 and running companies since I was 25. Somewhere in between I learned that the best things get built by people who are honest about what they don't know.
about.p2: I surround myself with people smarter than me, I learn fast, and I try to pass it on. Most of what I know came from someone being patient enough to explain it.
about.p3: Currently running <tdb>The Digital Bunch</tdb> across three countries, launching new ventures in Saudi Arabia, and still shipping code most days.
